title: Elemental statuses on a monster, as this phone predicts them
oneLine: Local per-monster status map: apply, refresh, frame-counted expiry, collision consume, resonance streak and mana restore.
topConcern: Phone restores mana and pops +MP on every collision; worker pays only resonating ones. Statuses tick 16.7 ms a pass, not real time.

title: The codex's discovered lists, kept per browser
oneLine: Four module Sets (collisions, monsters, materials, zones) loaded from localStorage at import, written on first discovery.
topConcern: Per-character progress lives per device and is wiped on every character switch; the dashboard codex reads other fields nobody writes.

title: A guild's quest ladder: rung shown vs rung paid
oneLine: Client _guildProgress picks the shown rung; worker's guild_claims count settles; adopted only from guild_quest_result.
topConcern: Worker's claims never reach the phone at join, so a new device or switch shows rung 0 while the worker is on rung n.

title: Deploy-order switches held in the data layer
oneLine: Module booleans (abilities, block scale, fish heal, t2 bench, grids, t2 simple, gear quality) set from state_sync caps.
topConcern: Defaults disagree before first state_sync; one try block means one throwing setter leaves later flags stale.

title: A quest's state for one character and who offers what
oneLine: rpg._quests per quest: available, active, complete, turnedIn; getNpcQuest decides offers; worker's _questBarred decides acceptance.
topConcern: Stored 'complete' has no writer: getNpcQuest skips it, journal says ready, worker refuses its hand-in; offer rules split across sides.

title: Which building doors count as reachable for a quest
oneLine: Door memo from WORLD_PROPS plus Wheel doors, minus closed zones; invalidated by two setters called at world-mode apply.
topConcern: Worker never asks about doors, so a hidden quest can still be accepted elsewhere; no live quest is walled today.

title: This phone's cached character record, migrated and predicted before the worker speaks
oneLine: bt_rpg boot copy runs five one-time migrations and local XP/level prediction until the worker's full player_state.
topConcern: migrateLifeSkills skips four skills and non-object skills the worker heals; stamps live only per browser.

title: The Dungeon Workshop's unlocks: bosses beaten, packs bought
oneLine: Client-only pack ownership and boss-clear gates for the farm's custom dungeon; the worker sanitizes config, ignores packs.
topConcern: Boss-gated packs read dungeonClears keys like ember_mid; the worker writes wheel_verdant/workshop, so they can never unlock.

title: A harvest's wind-up clock (the explicit half)
oneLine: Timing table and pure schedulers for the harvest attempt: plan wait, hit lead, settle, gesture window, open delay.

title: Client-side factories for dormant or retired systems
oneLine: Minigame instance status, clan war object, gathering node, market order, pet evolution, anniversary latch; no live callers.
topConcern: Dead lifecycle objects beside live ones (depleted vs alive) invite a revival by mistake.

title: The current-zone-size globals
oneLine: TOWN_W/TOWN_H/COLS/ROWS let bindings reassigned on zone changes, plus a boot-frozen globalThis copy.
topConcern: Two copies can disagree; only the NPC wander clamp reads them and skips them in the Wheel.

title: Tables here that drive machines living elsewhere
oneLine: Ability timings, cue gaps, achievement ids, boss split size, arena poll cadence, drop clocks, combat timing constants.
topConcern: Arena poll's _arenaMatch needs a status field today's route never sends; readers rely on _inDuel instead.

title: The comprehensive stats record (compStats)
oneLine: Client-owned vanity counters with a 60-frame playtime tick and a _sessionStart stamped only at creation.
topConcern: Playtime counts frames, so slow phones log less; old SkillsPanel adds now minus creation time as a session.

title: The old map's exits and the World View arrival
oneLine: Old town and World View exit tables plus the hub exit-disarm deaf window in zoneTransitions.
